verdict.rationale: Weave documents a Service API reference with REST endpoints for programmatic access (docs-15), so an API reference exists. Nothing shows it is interactive or offers runnable 'try it' examples. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths, and the Playground is an LLM prompt tool, not an API explorer, so it is not credited. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples in the reference, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration
